macros.name: framebreak
macros.doc: The command \framebreak is a shorthand for \pagebreak<presentation> and \noframebreak is a shorthand for \nopagebreak<presentation>.

macros.name: includeonlyframes
macros.doc: This command behaves a little bit like the \includeonly command: Only the frames mentioned in the list are included.

macros.name: resetcounteronoverlays
macros.doc: After you have invoked this command, the value of the specified counter will be the same on all slides of every frame.
